NONE: › (used especially in newspapers) to marry someone

example: The couple eventually wed after an 18-year engagement.
這對情侶在訂婚18年後終於結婚了。
See also
newlywed
We'd better be more careful in the future.
我們將來最好更謹慎些。
We'd be grateful for an answer.
若蒙回覆，不勝感激。

NONE: › believing firmly in an idea or theory and unwilling to change that belief

example: Managers can become wedded to a certain way of doing things.
管理人員在行事方式上可能會形成一套固定的做法。
your lawful wedded husband/wife
你的合法丈夫／妻子
Elaine and Fran have been living in wedded bliss for almost a year now.
伊萊恩與弗蘭已經度過了快一年幸福美滿的婚姻生活。

NONE: B1 a marriage ceremony and any celebrations such as a meal or a party that follow it

example: a wedding cake/dress/invitation/present/reception
婚禮蛋糕／禮服／請柬／禮物／招待會
Do you know the date of Caroline and Matthew's wedding?
你知道卡羅琳和馬修的婚禮哪天舉行嗎？
It was their 25th wedding anniversary last week.
上週是他們結婚25週年紀念。

NONE: › a list of all the things that two people who are soon to be married would like to receive as presents, often kept at a particular shop
（即將結婚的情侶列出的希望收到作為新婚禮物的）婚禮物品清單
› a person or company whose job is to organize weddings for other people
› a party to celebrate the marriage ceremony of two people

example: The wedding will be held at St Martin's Church and the wedding reception at the Crathorne Hotel.
婚禮將在聖馬丁教堂舉行，婚宴設在克萊桑飯店。

NONE: › a ring, usually made of gold, worn to show that you are married

C: › [ C ] a piece of metal, wood, rubber, etc. with a pointed edge at one end and a wide edge at the other, either pushed between two objects to keep them still or forced into something to break pieces off it
（金屬、木頭或橡膠等製成的）楔子，三角木
› [ C ] a piece of something, especially food, in the shape of a triangle
楔形物，三角形物（尤指食物）

NONE: › women's shoes with a heel all the way under the shoe
整個鞋底都有鞋跟的女鞋，坡跟鞋
› to make something stay in a particular position by using a wedge
› to put something into a very small or narrow space, so that it cannot move easily

example: Push a wedge under the door to keep it open while we're carrying the boxes in.
在門底下塞一個楔子讓門敞開著，我們好往裡面搬箱子。
Pieces of stone can be split off by forcing wedges between the layers.
在層與層之間敲入楔子可以把石頭鑿開。
Auntie Ann put a huge wedge of cake on my plate.
安姨媽把一大塊三角形的蛋糕放在我盤子裡。
a wedge of cheese
一塊三角形的起司
[ + adj ] Find something to wedge the window open/closed with.
找個甚麼東西楔住窗戶，讓它開著／關緊。
Her shoe came off and got wedged between the bars.
她的鞋掉了下來，卡在欄杆中間。
I was standing waiting for a bus, wedged between (= fixed between and unable to move away from) two old ladies and their bags of shopping.
我正站著等公共汽車，夾在兩位上了年紀的女士和她們的購物袋中間，動彈不得。

NONE: A1 the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday

example: Did you say the meeting is on Wednesday?
你是說會議在星期三開嗎？
The restaurant is always closed on Wednesdays.
那家餐館總是在星期三休業。
Next Wednesday is my birthday.
下個星期三是我的生日。
I didn't go to school last Wednesday.
我上週三沒有去學校。
29 April is a Wednesday.
4月29日是一個星期三。
Wednesday morning/afternoon/evening/night
星期三早上／下午／傍晚／晚上
